projects.title: String Constant Pool (SCP) Reference vs Content Equality Verifier
projects.description: Demonstrate JVM String Constant Pool mechanics by comparing two string literals against a string object created via constructor allocation (new String()). Inspect reference equality (==) vs content equality (.equals()) to prove that identical literals point to the same SCP memory address while 'new String()' forces a new Heap allocation.
projects.exampleText: Compare s1 = "Java", s2 = "Java", s3 = new String("Java")
projects.exampleOutput:
Literal vs Literal (==)   : true  [Shared SCP Memory]
Literal vs Heap Obj (==)  : false [Distinct Heap Object]
Literal vs Heap (.equals) : true  [Equivalent Character Value]
projects.learningOutcome: Differentiate between reference address identity in the String Constant Pool and semantic value equivalence.

projects.title: Dynamic String Interning & Deduplication Engine
projects.description: Simulate a data ingestion pipeline where duplicate dynamically calculated strings (created via runtime operations or user input in normal Heap memory) are interned using intern() to point to the shared canonical instance inside the String Constant Pool.
projects.exampleText: Dynamically build dynamicStr = new String("Batch-A") and invoke .intern()
projects.exampleOutput:
Before intern(): scpBase == dynamicStr -> false
After intern() : scpBase == dynamicStr.intern() -> true
Memory Optimization: Canonical reference retrieved from SCP.
projects.learningOutcome: Master the intern() method to enforce string deduplication in memory-constrained JVM services.

projects.title: String Immutability Proof & Modification Detector
projects.description: Prove that String objects in Java cannot be modified in-place. Demonstrate that method calls such as concat() or toUpperCase() generate brand-new String instances in memory without altering the caller's original reference.
projects.exampleText: Execute s.concat(" Developer") on s = "Java" without reassigning the variable
projects.exampleOutput:
Original before operations: Java [Address: 1989780873]
Result of concat() call   : Java Developer [Address: 1480010240]
Original after operations : Java [Address: 1989780873] [UNALTERED]
Immutability Confirmed    : true
projects.learningOutcome: Understand why all String transformation methods return new instances rather than mutating existing memory buffers.

projects.title: Security Clearance Token & Constant Pool Integrity Validator
projects.description: Model an authorization gateway to illustrate why String immutability is critical for system security: demonstrate how passing immutable role strings guarantees that untrusted methods cannot tamper with user access permissions across application boundaries.
projects.exampleText: Pass userRole = "ROLE_STUDENT" into an untrusted third-party audit module
projects.exampleOutput:
Gateway received: ROLE_STUDENT
Third-party plugin attempted role escalation...
Gateway final evaluation: Access restricted safely to 'ROLE_STUDENT'.
projects.learningOutcome: Analyze how String immutability protects Java applications from unauthorized state mutations and security exploits.

projects.title: Two-Pointer Palindrome Verification (Zero Heap Garbage)
projects.description: Validate whether a given word or alphanumeric sentence reads the same forwards and backwards using symmetric index pointers, avoiding unnecessary reverse string creation or intermediate Heap garbage allocation.
projects.exampleText: Evaluate input = "Madam in Eden, I'm Adam!"
projects.exampleOutput:
Input: "Madam in Eden, I'm Adam!"
Is Palindrome: true
Heap Allocation: 0 additional String objects created
projects.learningOutcome: Implement memory-efficient string inspection algorithms using charAt() and two-pointer loops.

projects.title: Student Email Sanitizer & Domain Extractor
projects.description: Clean messy email entries from campus registration portals (e.g. Barrackpore & Shyamnagar study centers), trimming whitespace, validating structure, and extracting the student username and institutional domain.
projects.exampleOutput:
Clean Email : swadeep.ghosh@barrackpore-college.edu
Username    : swadeep.ghosh
Domain      : barrackpore-college.edu
Is College  : true
projects.learningOutcome: Utilize strip(), substring(), and indexOf() for robust string parsing and data cleansing.

projects.title: Sensitive PII Credit Card & Aadhaar Masking Tool
projects.description: Mask private identification numbers (12-digit Aadhaar or 16-digit payment cards) by obscuring all leading numbers with asterisks and retaining only the terminal 4 digits for verification.
projects.exampleOutput:
Card Masked   : ************9876
Aadhaar Masked: ********5678
projects.learningOutcome: Combine substring() with repeat() to implement secure data masking workflows.

projects.title: Character Category & Frequency Analyzer
projects.description: Parse a paragraph of source text and compute total counts of vowels, consonants, numerical digits, whitespace, and punctuation symbols using primitive char array inspection.
projects.exampleOutput: Vowels: 10 | Consonants: 15 | Digits: 5 | Spaces: 6 | Symbols: 4
projects.learningOutcome: Convert strings into primitive char arrays via toCharArray() for high-performance classification.

projects.title: Title Case Word Capitalizer
projects.description: Transform inconsistent or all-caps document titles into standard Title Case, capitalizing the first letter of every word while converting remaining letters to lowercase.
projects.exampleText: Format title = "jAvA sTRiNg cOnSTanT pOOL aRChitECture"
projects.exampleOutput: Formatted Title: Java String Constant Pool Architecture
projects.learningOutcome: Combine split(), substring(), and String.join() to perform structured string transformations.

projects.title: Substring Occurrence & Overlap Counter
projects.description: Search for a target pattern inside a corpus of text and accurately count both non-overlapping and overlapping occurrences using index-based scanning.
projects.exampleOutput:
Non-overlapping matches: 2
Overlapping matches: 4
Match Indices: [1, 3, 8, 10]
projects.learningOutcome: Leverage indexOf() with index offsets to navigate text buffers without allocating excess objects.

projects.title: URL Protocol, Host, Port, and Path Parser
projects.description: Break down a network URL string into its discrete structural parts: scheme/protocol, hostname, optional port number, and resource endpoint path without external libraries.
projects.exampleOutput: Protocol: https | Host: api.coderaccotax.in | Port: 8443 | Path: /v1/students/records
projects.learningOutcome: Decompose complex structured protocol strings using substring and delimiter boundaries.

projects.title: CSV Line Parser with Escaped Delimiter Handling
projects.description: Parse CSV record lines where values containing commas are enclosed in double quotes (e.g. "Ghosh, Swadeep"), avoiding erroneous splits from naive comma separation.
projects.exampleOutput:
Field 1: 101
Field 2: Hui, Sukanta
Field 3: Barrackpore
Field 4: Computer Science, Java
projects.learningOutcome: Implement stateful character-by-character string parsing to handle complex data formats like CSV.

projects.title: Lexicographical String Sorter & Custom compareTo() Inspector
projects.description: Sort an array of student names alphabetically using bubble sort driven by compareTo(), and demonstrate how underlying ASCII difference math determines ordering.
projects.exampleOutput:
Sorted: ["Abhronila", "Debangshu", "Swadeep", "Tuhina"]
ASCII Difference ('T' - 'A'): 19
projects.learningOutcome: Master the mechanics of compareTo() and lexicographical Unicode collation.

projects.title: Custom Word Replacement Engine (Simulating replace())
projects.description: Implement a replacement algorithm that locates and replaces all occurrences of a target word with a replacement string without using Java's built-in replace() or regex methods.
projects.exampleText: In "Java is fast. Java is versatile.", replace "Java" with "Python"
projects.exampleOutput:
Original: "Java is fast. Java is versatile."
Replaced: "Python is fast. Python is versatile."
projects.learningOutcome: Construct replacement pipelines using substring and indices while adhering to immutability.

projects.title: Anagram Evaluator Using Character Frequency Arrays
projects.description: Verify if two candidate phrases are anagrams (contain the exact same letters in different order) by normalizing whitespace and case, then comparing character counts with a fixed 26-element integer array.
projects.exampleOutput:
Normalized: "debitcard" vs "badcredit"
Are Anagrams: true
projects.learningOutcome: Combine string normalization with frequency array algorithms for fast text comparison.

projects.title: Run-Length String Compression & Decompression Utility
projects.description: Encode sequential repeating characters into compact character-count pairs (e.g. "aaaabbc" -> "a4b2c1") and decode it back, comparing memory footprint savings.
projects.exampleOutput:
Compressed: W12B1W12B3
Decompressed: WWWWWWWWWWWWBWWWWWWWWWWWWBBB
Compression Ratio: 44.4%
projects.learningOutcome: Implement lossless compression algorithms leveraging sequential charAt() inspection.

projects.title: Caesar Cipher Text Encryptor & Decryptor
projects.description: Build a classical Caesar Cipher encryption tool that shifts alphabetic letters by a secret key while preserving punctuation, case, and whitespace intact.
projects.exampleText: Encrypt "Meet at Barrackpore Station!" with shift = 4
projects.exampleOutput:
Encrypted: QIIX EX FEVEGOMTSVI WXEXMSR!
Decrypted: MEET AT BARRACKPORE STATION!
projects.learningOutcome: Perform in-memory character transformations on char arrays and construct new String instances.

projects.title: Robust Password Security Evaluator & Rule Breakdown
projects.description: Inspect a candidate user password across 5 distinct security parameters: minimum length (>= 8), uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numeric digits, and special characters (#, $, %, &, @).
projects.exampleOutput:
Length: OK (13) | Upper: OK (2) | Lower: OK (6) | Digits: OK (4) | Special: OK (1)
Strength: VERY STRONG (100/100)
projects.learningOutcome: Synthesize string length checks and character inspections into enterprise-grade input validation.

projects.title: Essay Word & Sentence Counter with Empty/Blank String Guard
projects.description: Build a document statistics engine that calculates total characters, words, sentences, and average word length, properly distinguishing between empty ("") and blank ("   ") text.
projects.exampleText: Process document with varied spacing, tabs, and sentences
projects.exampleOutput:
Total Words     : 42
Total Sentences : 3
Avg Word Length : 4.82 chars
projects.learningOutcome: Safely handle null, empty, and blank strings while calculating text metrics.

projects.title: String Pool Deduplication Simulator & Memory Footprint Analyzer
projects.description: Simulate a miniature String Constant Pool inside a custom repository. Demonstrate how deduplicating 10,000 student records sharing city names ("Barrackpore", "Kolkata", "Naihati") saves heap memory.
projects.exampleText: Feed 1,000 city names with only 5 unique variations
projects.exampleOutput:
Without Pooling: 1000 objects allocated (~32,000 bytes)
With Custom Pool: 5 objects allocated (~160 bytes)
Memory Saved: 99.5%
projects.learningOutcome: Understand how the JVM String Constant Pool prevents redundant heap object proliferation.

projects.title: Semantic Version Number Comparator
projects.description: Compare two software release versions (e.g. "1.10.2" vs "1.2.9") numerically by segment, overcoming the flaw where alphabetical compareTo() erroneously marks "1.2.9" greater than "1.10.2".
projects.exampleOutput:
Version 1 : 2.10.1
Version 2 : 2.4.9
Comparison: v1 is NEWER (+1)
projects.learningOutcome: Parse numerical segments from delimited strings and execute boundary-safe comparisons.

projects.title: File Path Extension & MIME Type Resolver
projects.description: Extract the extension from complex local file paths (handling hidden UNIX files, dots in directory folders, and files without extensions), mapping the result to its standard MIME content type.
projects.exampleOutput:
Filename: project.v2.final.PDF
Extension: pdf
MIME Type: application/pdf
projects.learningOutcome: Combine lastIndexOf() and substring() to handle edge-case file system metadata parsing.
